Quantum 1.7.1 was certified on 2026-07-19. It pins **nucleus v1.3.2**, **quark v1.3.1** and **orbit v1.4.2**.

A patch release of the suite after Quantum 1.7.0: nucleus goes from v1.3.1 to v1.3.2 (patch), quark goes from v1.3.0 to v1.3.1 (patch) and orbit goes from v1.4.1 to v1.4.2 (patch).
